title: A2A and Agent Communication Protocols
subtitle: MCP, A2A, ACP, ANP and FIPA-ACL side by side. Agent Cards, tasks, wire names and failures. A2A 1.0.1.
markdown:
## Four protocols side by side
type: comparison
span: 2
from: phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/03-communication-protocols/docs/en.md

| Factor | MCP | A2A | ACP | ANP |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Primary use | Agent to Tool | Agent to Agent | Agent to Agent | Agent to Agent |
| Spec format | JSON-RPC | JSON-RPC / REST / gRPC | OpenAPI 3.1 (REST) | JSON-RPC |
| Discovery | Tool listing | `/.well-known/agent-card.json` | `GET /agents`, `/.well-known/agent.yml` | `/.well-known/agent-descriptions` |
| Identity | Implicit (local) | Security schemes (OAuth, mTLS) | Server-level | W3C DID (`did:wba`) with E2EE |
| Audit trail | N/A | Basic (task history) | TrajectoryMetadata | Not formally specified |
| Streaming | N/A | SSE | SSE | Transport-agnostic |
| Unique feature | Tool schemas | Agent Cards + Skills | Trajectory audit trail | Meta-protocol negotiation |
| Status | Stable | Stable (v1.0) | Merging into A2A | Active development |

## Use X when
type: concepts
from: phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/03-communication-protocols/docs/en.md, phases/13-tools-and-protocols/19-a2a-protocol/docs/en.md, phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/12-a2a-protocol/docs/en.md

- **MCP**: you want to invoke a specific tool. Agent to tool.
- **A2A**: you want to delegate a whole task to another agent.
- **A2A + ACP patterns**: you need audit trails for compliance.
- **ANP + A2A**: agents are outside your org and share no infrastructure.
- **A2A + message broker**: external agents on shared infrastructure.
- **Direct RPC**: latency-sensitive micro-calls. A2A's lifecycle is async.
- **No protocol**: agents do not need to talk to each other.

## A2A call over HTTP+JSON
type: architecture
from: phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/12-a2a-protocol/docs/en.md, phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/12-a2a-protocol/code/main.py

```arch
node | client | 1,1 | Client agent | sends A2A-Version: 1.0 | client
node | card | 2,1 | Agent Card | /.well-known/agent-card.json | store
node | send | 1,2 | POST /message:send | returnImmediately | process
node | store | 2,2 | TaskStore | state + artifacts | store
node | poll | 3,2 | GET /tasks/{id} | until a terminal state | process
edge | client | card | discover
edge | client | send | message
edge | send | store | create task
edge | store | poll | task
```

## Task lifecycle with a pause
type: flow
from: phases/13-tools-and-protocols/19-a2a-protocol/docs/en.md, phases/13-tools-and-protocols/19-a2a-protocol/code/main.py, phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/03-communication-protocols/docs/en.md

1. **Client**: sends `SendMessage` with no `taskId`. The server creates the Task.
2. **Server**: sets `TASK_STATE_SUBMITTED`, then `TASK_STATE_WORKING`.
3. **Server**: data is missing. It sets `TASK_STATE_INPUT_REQUIRED` with a `ROLE_AGENT` message.
4. **Client**: sends a new message with the same `taskId` and a `data` part.
5. **Server**: goes back to `TASK_STATE_WORKING` and adds an Artifact.
6. **Server**: sets `TASK_STATE_COMPLETED`. Terminal states are immutable.
7. **Client**: a follow-up creates a new task within the same `contextId`.

## A2A tasks on the wire
type: task-table
span: 2
from: phases/13-tools-and-protocols/19-a2a-protocol/docs/en.md, phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/12-a2a-protocol/docs/en.md, phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/12-a2a-protocol/code/main.py

| Task | Code |
|---|---|
| Discover an agent | `GET /.well-known/agent-card.json` |
| Send and wait (JSON-RPC) | `"method": "SendMessage"` |
| Send, return at once (HTTP+JSON) | `POST /message:send` with `configuration.returnImmediately` |
| Poll a task | `GetTask` or `GET /tasks/{id}` |
| Stream a task over SSE | `SendStreamingMessage` or `POST /message:stream` |
| Reattach to a running task | `SubscribeToTask` or `/tasks/{id}:subscribe` |
| Cancel or list tasks | `CancelTask`, `ListTasks` |
| Run the demo server and client | `python3 code/main.py` |

## Agent Card and Message shape
type: annotated-code
lang: json
from: phases/13-tools-and-protocols/19-a2a-protocol/docs/en.md

```json
{"name": "research-agent", "version": "1.2.0",
 "supportedInterfaces": [{"url": "<url>",           // pick the first binding you speak
   "protocolBinding": "JSONRPC", "protocolVersion": "1.0"}],
 "capabilities": {"streaming": true, "pushNotifications": true},
 "securitySchemes": {"bearer": {"httpAuthSecurityScheme": {"scheme": "Bearer"}}},
 "securityRequirements": [{"schemes": {"bearer": {"list": []}}}],
 "defaultInputModes": ["text/plain"],               // media types
 "skills": [{"id": "summarize_paper", "tags": ["research"]}]}
{"messageId": "msg-001", "role": "ROLE_USER",       // or ROLE_AGENT
 "parts": [{"text": "Summarize this paper."},       // one content field per Part
   {"raw": "...", "filename": "paper.pdf", "mediaType": "application/pdf"},
   {"data": {"targetLength": "3 paragraphs"}}]}     // no kind field
```

## Defaults and numbers
type: defaults
from: phases/13-tools-and-protocols/19-a2a-protocol/docs/en.md, phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/12-a2a-protocol/docs/en.md, phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/12-a2a-protocol/code/main.py, phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/03-communication-protocols/docs/en.md

| Setting | Default | Note |
|---|---|---|
| `A2A_VERSION` | "1.0" | Send `A2A-Version: 1.0` on every request |
| No `A2A-Version` header | 0.3 | The server reads the request as version 0.3 |
| `returnImmediately` | False | `SendMessage` blocks until terminal or interrupted |
| `A2A_MEDIA_TYPE` | "application/a2a+json" | Content type of the HTTP+JSON binding |
| `PORT` | 8765 | Lesson 16.12 demo server |
| ANP negotiation | max 10 rounds | Then timeout |

## FIPA-ACL heritage
type: comparison
from: phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/02-fipa-acl-heritage/docs/en.md

| Modern spec | FIPA analog | Keeps | Drops |
|---|---|---|---|
| MCP `tools/call` | `request` | intent, correlation id | semantics, ontology |
| MCP `resources/read` | `query-ref` | intent, correlation id | formal semantics |
| A2A Task lifecycle | contract-net + request-when | async lifecycle | completeness guarantees |
| A2A streaming events | subscribe/notify | async push | typed-predicate subscription |
| NLIP | natural-language content | LLM-native | schema |

## Troubleshooting
type: troubleshooting
from: phases/13-tools-and-protocols/19-a2a-protocol/code/main.py, phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/12-a2a-protocol/code/main.py, phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/03-communication-protocols/docs/en.md, phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/02-fipa-acl-heritage/docs/en.md, phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/12-a2a-protocol/docs/en.md

| Symptom | Cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| JSON-RPC error `-32009` | Missing or wrong `A2A-Version` | Send `A2A-Version: 1.0` |
| JSON-RPC error `-32601` | Unknown method name | Use PascalCase names such as `SendMessage` |
| HTTP 400 `VERSION_NOT_SUPPORTED` | HTTP+JSON call without the header | Add the header to every request |
| HTTP 404 `TASK_NOT_FOUND` | Unknown task id on `GET /tasks/{id}` | Use the id from the `task` reply |
| Updates after completion lost | Task is immutable once terminal | Check terminal state before you yield |
| Garbage after a card update | Schema drift between versions | Version skills and output schemas |
| Same word, wrong action | Semantic drift without ontology | JSON Schema on `content`, typed artifacts |
| 50 agents hit `GET /agents` | Discovery thundering herd | Cache Agent Cards with TTL |

## Abbreviations
type: glossary
from: phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/03-communication-protocols/docs/en.md, phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/02-fipa-acl-heritage/docs/en.md, phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/12-a2a-protocol/docs/en.md

- **A2A**: Agent2Agent. Peer protocol with Agent Cards and tasks.
- **ACP**: Agent Communication Protocol. REST runs with TrajectoryMetadata.
- **ANP**: Agent Network Protocol. `did:wba` identity and HPKE E2EE.
- **DID**: Decentralized Identifier. W3C identity on the agent's own domain.
- **NLIP**: Ecma Natural Language Interaction Protocol. Natural-language content type.
- **FIPA**: Foundation for Intelligent Physical Agents. Standardized ACL in 2000.
- **ACL**: Agent Communication Language. Performative plus content plus metadata.
- **KQML**: Knowledge Query and Manipulation Language (1993). FIPA's predecessor.

## Questions
type: qa
from: phases/13-tools-and-protocols/19-a2a-protocol/docs/en.md, phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/12-a2a-protocol/docs/en.md, phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/03-communication-protocols/docs/en.md, phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/02-fipa-acl-heritage/docs/en.md

- **What does the caller see in A2A?** Task state and artifacts. The called agent's internals stay opaque.
- **How do I stop duplicate tasks on retry?** Deduplicate on the client's `messageId`.
- **How is an Agent Card signed?** A JWS in `signatures` over the RFC 8785 canonical JSON, without `signatures`.
- **What does ACP add?** Each part can carry `tool_name`, `tool_input` and `tool_output` metadata.
- **DID fetch fails. Open or closed?** Fail closed with the principle of least trust.
- **Which FIPA protocols are worth porting?** Contract Net, Subscribe/Notify and Request-When.

title: A2A Protocol
subtitle: Cards, messages, tasks, states, the three bindings, errors and the 0.3 layer of A2A 1.0.1. Facts from the manual.
markdown:
## Protocol architecture
type: architecture
from: manuals/a2a-101/sections/1-1-what-a2a-standardizes.md, manuals/a2a-101/sections/2-1-agentcard-fields.md, manuals/a2a-101/sections/2-2-discovery-and-supported-interfaces.md, manuals/a2a-101/sections/5-1-json-rpc.md, manuals/a2a-101/sections/5-2-http-json.md, manuals/a2a-101/sections/7-2-a-server.md

```arch
node | planner | 1,1 | Planner | client, reads cards | client
node | card | 1,2 | AgentCard | /.well-known/agent-card.json | client
node | jsonrpc | 2,1 | JSON-RPC | /a2a/jsonrpc | process
node | handler | 3,1 | Handler | checks, then executor | process
node | rest | 3,2 | HTTP+JSON | /a2a/rest | process
node | store | 4,1 | Task store | record of each task | store
edge | planner | card | GET
edge | planner | jsonrpc | POST
edge | jsonrpc | handler | method
edge | rest | handler | route
edge | handler | store | task
```

## Send and read a task
type: task-table
from: manuals/a2a-101/sections/2-2-discovery-and-supported-interfaces.md, manuals/a2a-101/sections/4-1-send-message.md, manuals/a2a-101/sections/5-1-json-rpc.md, manuals/a2a-101/sections/5-4-version-and-extension-headers.md, manuals/a2a-101/capture/out/01-agent-cards.http

| Task | Code |
|---|---|
| Read the agent card | `GET /.well-known/agent-card.json HTTP/1.1` |
| Send one message | `"method": "SendMessage"` posted to `/a2a/jsonrpc` |
| Send the version | `A2A-Version: 1.0` |
| Send and return at once | `"returnImmediately": true` in `configuration` |
| Open a stream | `"method": "SendStreamingMessage"` |

## Commands over HTTP+JSON
type: command-table
from: manuals/a2a-101/sections/5-2-http-json.md, manuals/a2a-101/sections/4-4-cancel-task-and-terminal-states.md, manuals/a2a-101/capture/out/16-rest-binding.http

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `POST /a2a/rest/message:send` | Sends a message. The reply is a task or a message. |
| `POST /a2a/rest/tasks/<task id>:cancel` | Asks the server to stop a task that is not terminal. |
| `GET /.well-known/agent-card.json` | Reads the agent card from the well-known path. |
| `POST /a2a/rest/tasks/<task id>:cancel` | Returns a task error when the task is already terminal. |

## Settings and defaults
type: defaults
from: manuals/a2a-101/sections/4-1-send-message.md, manuals/a2a-101/sections/4-3-get-task-and-list-tasks.md, manuals/a2a-101/sections/2-1-agentcard-fields.md, manuals/a2a-101/sections/5-4-version-and-extension-headers.md

| Setting | Default | Note |
|---|---|---|
| `returnImmediately` | false | A send waits for a terminal or interrupted state |
| `historyLength` | unset | The server decides how much history to return. `0` returns no history. |
| `pageSize` | 50 | The maximum in `ListTasks` is 100 |
| `includeArtifacts` | false | Artifacts are left out of list results |
| `A2A-Version` | 1.0 | Required on every request, with no patch number |

## Compare the bindings
type: comparison
from: manuals/a2a-101/sections/5-1-json-rpc.md, manuals/a2a-101/sections/5-2-http-json.md, manuals/a2a-101/sections/5-3-grpc.md, manuals/a2a-101/sections/5-5-errors.md, manuals/a2a-101/sections/5-4-version-and-extension-headers.md

| Factor | JSON-RPC | HTTP+JSON | gRPC |
|---|---|---|---|
| Operation named by | `method`, such as `SendMessage` | route, such as `POST /message:send` | rpc `SendMessage` in `A2AService` |
| Where it is sent | one URL, `/a2a/jsonrpc` in the kit | one route per operation | `lf.a2a.v1.A2AService` over HTTP/2 with TLS |
| Stream frame | a `data:` line with a full JSON-RPC response | a `data:` line with the `StreamResponse` alone | a server-streaming rpc of `StreamResponse` |
| `TaskNotFoundError` | `-32001` with HTTP 200 | HTTP 404 | `NOT_FOUND` |
| Version header | `A2A-Version` header | `A2A-Version` header | `a2a-version` metadata key |

## Task states
type: concepts
from: manuals/a2a-101/sections/3-4-task-and-task-state.md, manuals/a2a-101/sections/4-2-input-required-and-auth-required.md, manuals/a2a-101/sections/4-4-cancel-task-and-terminal-states.md

- **Active**: `TASK_STATE_SUBMITTED` and `TASK_STATE_WORKING`. The agent is still working.
- **Interrupted**: `TASK_STATE_INPUT_REQUIRED` and `TASK_STATE_AUTH_REQUIRED`. The task waits for you.
- **Terminal**: `TASK_STATE_COMPLETED`, `TASK_STATE_FAILED`, `TASK_STATE_CANCELED`, `TASK_STATE_REJECTED`. The task never changes again.
- **TASK_STATE_UNSPECIFIED**: never sent by the kit. Treat it as an error.

## One task, step by step
type: flow
from: manuals/a2a-101/sections/1-1-what-a2a-standardizes.md, manuals/a2a-101/sections/3-1-message.md, manuals/a2a-101/sections/4-1-send-message.md, manuals/a2a-101/sections/4-2-input-required-and-auth-required.md, manuals/a2a-101/sections/4-3-get-task-and-list-tasks.md

1. **Client**: sends a blocking `SendMessage` with a new `messageId` and no `taskId`.
2. **Server**: creates the task and mints its `taskId` and `contextId`.
3. **Agent**: stops at `TASK_STATE_INPUT_REQUIRED`, and the call returns the task with its question.
4. **Client**: answers with a second `SendMessage` with the same `taskId` and `contextId`.
5. **Server**: returns the same task in `TASK_STATE_COMPLETED`, with its artifact.
6. **Client**: calls `GetTask` with the `taskId` to read the stored task again.

## JSON-RPC request
type: annotated-code
lang: bash
from: manuals/a2a-101/sections/5-1-json-rpc.md, manuals/a2a-101/sections/3-1-message.md, manuals/a2a-101/sections/5-4-version-and-extension-headers.md, manuals/a2a-101/capture/out/02-message-reply.http

```bash
curl -s http://localhost:41242/a2a/jsonrpc \  # one URL for every operation
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \  # JSON body
  -H 'A2A-Version: 1.0' \  # required on every request
  -d '{
    "jsonrpc": "2.0",  # envelope version, always 2.0
    "id": 1,  # the reply repeats this id
    "method": "SendMessage",  # PascalCase operation name
    "params": {"message": {
      "messageId": "d95bafc8-f2a4-427b-9cf4-bb99f4bea973",  # minted by the client
      "role": "ROLE_USER",  # the client always sends ROLE_USER
      "parts": [{"text": "What languages can you review?"}]  # at least one part
    }}
  }'
```

## Troubleshooting
type: troubleshooting
from: manuals/a2a-101/sections/5-4-version-and-extension-headers.md, manuals/a2a-101/sections/5-5-errors.md, manuals/a2a-101/sections/4-4-cancel-task-and-terminal-states.md, manuals/a2a-101/sections/7-4-from-0-3-to-1-0.md, manuals/a2a-101/sections/3-5-context-id.md

| Symptom | Cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| `-32009` on every call | No `A2A-Version` header | Send `A2A-Version: 1.0` |
| `-32601` with `message/send` | A 0.3 method name | Send `SendMessage` |
| `-32004` on a finished task | The task is terminal | Start a task with `referenceTaskIds` in the same context |
| `-32003` on a push config call | The card has no `pushNotifications` flag | Read the card before the call |
| `-32602` with a `BadRequest` detail | `message.messageId` is missing | Mint a `messageId` for every message |
| `-32001` or HTTP 404 | The id is unknown, purged, or hidden | Check the id, then stop |

## Questions and answers
type: qa
from: manuals/a2a-101/sections/4-1-send-message.md, manuals/a2a-101/sections/3-1-message.md, manuals/a2a-101/sections/3-3-artifact-and-chunks.md, manuals/a2a-101/sections/6-1-security-schemes-and-in-task-authorization.md

- **Why does a send wait?** The default `returnImmediately` is false. The call holds until a terminal or interrupted state.
- **Where is the result?** In `artifacts`. A message should not carry a task's output.
- **Why answer `TaskNotFoundError` for another caller's task?** The spec forbids revealing that a resource exists.

## Tips
type: tips
from: manuals/a2a-101/sections/3-1-message.md, manuals/a2a-101/sections/3-2-part.md, manuals/a2a-101/sections/4-3-get-task-and-list-tasks.md, manuals/a2a-101/sections/2-2-discovery-and-supported-interfaces.md

- Mint a new `messageId` for each new message. Reuse it only to retry.
- Send `ROLE_USER` from the client and `ROLE_AGENT` from the server.
- Send `historyLength` 0 for a status check.
- Read the card and check its capability flags before an optional call.

title: Agent Benchmarks: SWE-bench to OSWorld
subtitle: Pick the benchmark, gate on the right tests, check contamination and compare runs on equal denominators.

## Single-agent benchmarks side by side
type: comparison
span: 2
from: phases/14-agent-engineering/19-benchmarks-swebench-gaia/docs/en.md, phases/14-agent-engineering/20-benchmarks-webarena-osworld/docs/en.md

| Factor | SWE-bench | GAIA | WebArena | OSWorld |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Tests | Code patching | Generalist tool use | Web tasks, long horizon | Real computer tasks |
| Size | 2,294 issues, 12 Python repos | 466 questions, 300 private | 812 tasks, 4 apps | 369 tasks, 3 OSes |
| Agent input | Codebase at pre-fix commit + issue | Question. Web, multi-modality | Self-hosted apps + utilities | 1920×1080 screenshots |
| Evaluator | FAIL_TO_PASS and PASS_TO_PASS tests | Not given | Execution-based, gym APIs | Not given |
| Best at release | SWE-agent 12.5% | GPT-4 with plugins 15% | GPT-4 agent 14.41% | Best model 12.24% |
| Human | Not given | 92% | 78.24% | 72.36% |
| Main trap | Contamination | Confusion with code benchmarks | Stale pinned app versions | GUI grounding |

## Multi-agent benchmarks side by side
type: comparison
span: 2
from: phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/24-evaluation-coordination-benchmarks/docs/en.md

| Factor | MARBLE | COMMA | MedAgentBoard | SWE-bench Pro |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Measures | Star, chain, tree, graph topologies | Multimodal asymmetric information | 4 medical task categories | Uncontaminated, later cutoffs |
| Scoring | Milestone KPIs, partial progress | Agent-agent collaboration | Multi-agent vs single-LLM vs rules | 1865 problems, 41 repos |
| Headline | Graph best for research | Frontier models struggle vs random | Multi-agent does NOT dominate | ~23% on Pro vs 70%+ on Verified |
| Lesson | Cognitive planning adds ~3% | Measure before you claim | Many systems are over-engineered | Verified alone is not evidence |

## Use X when
type: tips
from: phases/14-agent-engineering/19-benchmarks-swebench-gaia/docs/en.md, phases/14-agent-engineering/20-benchmarks-webarena-osworld/docs/en.md, phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/24-evaluation-coordination-benchmarks/docs/en.md

- SWE-bench Verified: a code agent. Always report Verified scores.
- SWE-bench Pro: a contamination reality check. Pro is the current gating test.
- GAIA: a generalist agent. Use the private leaderboard split.
- AgentBench: a multi-environment comparison across 8 environments.
- WebArena Verified: a web agent. Self-host it for continuous evaluation.
- OSWorld: a desktop agent. Run it in a VM fleet.
- MARBLE: you compare coordination topologies apples-to-apples.
- AgentArch: you must justify each layer of an enterprise stack.
- Custom evals: your product flows. Capture gold trajectories for your top 20 tasks.

## SWE-bench gate: run_task
type: flow
from: phases/14-agent-engineering/19-benchmarks-swebench-gaia/code/main.py, phases/14-agent-engineering/19-benchmarks-swebench-gaia/docs/en.md

1. **Harness**: copy `state_before`. Count passing FAIL_TO_PASS and PASS_TO_PASS checks.
2. **Agent**: apply the patch to a copy of the state.
3. **Harness**: count passing checks again on the new state.
4. **Fix gate**: all FAIL_TO_PASS tests must pass after the patch.
5. **No-regression gate**: `ptp_broke` must be 0.
6. **Result**: `resolved` is true only when both gates pass.
7. **Report**: resolution rate is resolved tasks over all tasks.

## Toy harness metrics in Python
type: annotated-code
lang: python
from: phases/14-agent-engineering/19-benchmarks-swebench-gaia/code/main.py, phases/14-agent-engineering/20-benchmarks-webarena-osworld/code/main.py, phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/24-evaluation-coordination-benchmarks/code/main.py

```python
resolved = (ftp_post == len(task.fail_to_pass)) and (ptp_broke == 0)
score = steps + modalities + tools    # GAIA level: <=2 is 1, <=5 is 2, else 3
efficiency = steps / task.gold_steps  # trajectory efficiency, 1.0 is gold
delta = r["accuracy_seen"] - r["accuracy_held"]
contam_flag = "*" if delta > 0.1 else " "  # held-set accuracy is canonical
vs_random = r["accuracy_held"] - rand_baseline  # baseline 0.15
r = run_bench(sys, n_seen=40, n_held=160, seed=17)
```

from: projects/harness-bench/stages, projects/harness-bench/solution, projects/harness-bench/README.md, phases/14-agent-engineering/19-benchmarks-swebench-gaia/docs/en.md, phases/14-agent-engineering/20-benchmarks-webarena-osworld/docs/en.md, phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/24-evaluation-coordination-benchmarks/code/main.py

## Numbers to remember
type: concepts
from: phases/14-agent-engineering/19-benchmarks-swebench-gaia/docs/en.md, phases/14-agent-engineering/20-benchmarks-webarena-osworld/docs/en.md, phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/24-evaluation-coordination-benchmarks/docs/en.md, projects/harness-bench/README.md

- **SWE-bench+**: 32.67% of successful patches leaked solutions. 31.08% had weak tests.
- **Cutoffs**: over 94% of SWE-bench issues predate most model cutoffs.
- **OSWorld-Human**: top agents use 1.4-2.7x more steps than gold.
- **OSWorld-G**: 564 grounding-only samples. It splits grounding from planning.
- **Agent-team gain**: ~30-40 point delta on SWE-bench Pro.
- **Coordination tax**: appears past ~4 agents on graph topology.
- **Orchard replay**: baseline 1/3 in 3 calls, error-retry 2/3 in 4, evidence 3/3 in 3.
- **Not measured**: cost, adversarial safety, your domain and the worst 1% of tails.

## Claim checklist
type: qa
from: phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/24-evaluation-coordination-benchmarks/docs/en.md, phases/14-agent-engineering/19-benchmarks-swebench-gaia/docs/en.md, projects/harness-bench/README.md

- **Which benchmark and split?** Verified vs Pro is a large gap. A number on the wrong split is worthless.
- **Contamination check?** Was the benchmark released after the training cutoff? If not, treat with caution.
- **Which baseline?** Single-LLM, random and prior multi-agent work. Not an untuned copy of the same system.
- **Significance?** N trials, p-value and a confidence interval. Single runs mislead.
- **Cost disclosed?** Tokens per task and wall-clock. Report P50/P75/P95, not one number.
- **Comparable receipts?** Same dataset SHA-256, model config SHA-256 and call budget.
- **Retry on a wrong answer?** No. Error retries never inspect the expected answer.

title: Why Agents Fail
subtitle: Name the failure, find it in the trace, gate it. Detectors, MAST, retry storms, PVE and a trace debugger.
markdown:
## Symptoms, causes, fixes
type: troubleshooting
span: 2
from: phases/14-agent-engineering/26-failure-modes-agentic/docs/en.md, phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/23-failure-modes-mast-groupthink/docs/en.md, phases/14-agent-engineering/27-prompt-injection-defense/docs/en.md, phases/14-agent-engineering/25-multi-agent-debate/docs/en.md

| Symptom | Cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| Success message on a 400 error | Success hallucination | Re-probe state. Was the file actually created? |
| One wrong call triggers four API calls | Cascading error | Automated verification gates at every step |
| Downstream load goes to 10x | Retry storm | Circuit breakers and capped retry budgets per request |
| Gradual accuracy decay, no crash | Memory poisoning | Append-only log, provenance, unwritable verifier |
| Three agents give the same wrong answer | Monoculture collapse | Use diverse prompts and/or models |
| Two agents both think they are the reviewer | Role ambiguity | Explicit role contracts and acceptance tests per task |
| Agent A thinks done, agent B still runs | State drift | Versioned shared state, state-sync checkpoints |
| Retrieved page overrides the developer prompt | Indirect prompt injection | Treat all retrieved content as untrusted. Add PVE |

## Five recurring modes and their detectors
type: command-table
from: phases/14-agent-engineering/26-failure-modes-agentic/code/main.py, phases/14-agent-engineering/26-failure-modes-agentic/docs/en.md

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `detect_hallucinated_action` | Tool name not in `KNOWN_TOOLS` |
| `detect_scope_creep` | `write_file` call with no write word in the request |
| `detect_cascading_errors` | An error, then 2 or more tool calls after it |
| `detect_context_loss` | A "do not" token appears in tool args |
| `detect_tool_misuse` | Required args missing for the tool schema |
| `detect_success_hallucination` | Success claim, write intent, state unchanged |
| `tag(trace)` | Runs all `DETECTORS`, returns the labels |
| `python3 code/main.py` | Per-trace labels and aggregate distribution |

## MAST root categories
type: concepts
from: phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/23-failure-modes-mast-groupthink/docs/en.md, phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/23-failure-modes-mast-groupthink/code/main.py, phases/14-agent-engineering/26-failure-modes-agentic/docs/en.md

- **Source**: 1642 execution traces, 7 open-source MAS, 41-86.7% failure rate.
- **Specification Problems (41.77%)**: role ambiguity, unclear task, implicit success criteria.
- **Coordination Failures (36.94%)**: lost messages, unsynchronized shared state, state drift.
- **Verification Gaps (21.30%)**: one agent claims success and no one verifies.
- **Cost**: verification gaps are the most expensive per failure. They fail silently.
- **Code**: `categorize_incident(symptoms)` returns `spec`, `coord`, `verify` or `unknown`.

## Groupthink family
type: glossary
from: phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/23-failure-modes-mast-groupthink/docs/en.md, phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/23-failure-modes-mast-groupthink/code/main.py

- **Monoculture collapse**: same base model gives correlated errors. Signal `correlated_errors`.
- **Conformity bias**: agents align with the loudest peer. Signal `agreement_rate_spike`.
- **Deficient ToM**: agents cannot model each other. Signal `coordination_drop_long_horizon`.
- **Mixed-motive dynamics**: compromise-middle satisfies no one. Signal `compromise_outputs`.
- **Cascading reliability failures**: one error pattern triggers others. Signal `retry_amplification`.
- **STRATUS**: detection, diagnosis and validation agents. 1.5x mitigation success.

## Retry storm
type: flow
from: phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/23-failure-modes-mast-groupthink/docs/en.md

1. **Payment service**: fails 10% of requests.
2. **Order agent**: each retry is a new order-inventory check.
3. **Inventory service**: sees 2x normal load and starts timing out.
4. **Every order**: retries. Inventory sees 10x load. Cluster goes down.
5. **Fix**: a circuit breaker short-circuits with cached or default results.

## Circuit breaker and storm simulator
type: annotated-code
lang: python
from: phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/23-failure-modes-mast-groupthink/code/main.py

```python
breaker = CircuitBreaker()           # starts BreakerState.CLOSED
breaker.allow()                      # False while OPEN, inside cooldown
breaker.record(ok)                   # opens when error rate > threshold
# HALF_OPEN: one success closes, one failure opens again
service = DownstreamService()        # base_failure_rate 0.1
effective_rate = self.base_failure_rate + (self.load * 0.02)
while attempts_for_req < 4:          # retry budget per request
    ...
simulate_retry_storm(200, use_breaker=True, seed=0)
# returns total_calls, successes, short_circuits
```

type: troubleshooting
span: 1
from: projects/agent-trace-debugger/solution/main.ts, projects/agent-trace-debugger/solution/cli.ts, projects/agent-trace-debugger/stages/01-parse/docs/en.md, projects/agent-trace-debugger/README.md

## Questions
type: qa
from: phases/14-agent-engineering/26-failure-modes-agentic/docs/en.md, phases/14-agent-engineering/27-prompt-injection-defense/docs/en.md, phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/23-failure-modes-mast-groupthink/docs/en.md, projects/agent-trace-debugger/project.json, projects/agent-trace-debugger/README.md

- **Why is tagging only crashes not enough?** Most agent failures produce valid-looking output.
- **Why not guardrails at the end only?** The model already touched the world.
- **Which slow-failure proxies help?** Agreement rate, retry rate, output-length distribution.
- **Why subtract the union of child intervals?** Parallel children overlap. Their sum overcounts.
- **Why compare tokens and errors, not only wall time?** The sample keeps 100 ms while tokens rise by 200.

## Use X when
type: concepts

- **AutoGen**: proposer-critic dialogue.
- **Agno**: many short-lived Python agents, FastAPI.
- **Mastra**: TypeScript, Next.js or Vercel, Zod-typed tools.
- **Plain Python**: two LLM calls and a tool.

## Decision tree: recommend(p)
type: flow
from: phases/11-llm-engineering/17-agent-framework-tradeoffs/code/main.py

1. **plain python**: `total_llm_calls` 2 or fewer. No roles, dialogue, resume, fan-out or human interrupt.
2. **langgraph**: `needs_resume`, `needs_human_interrupt` or `has_parallel_fanout`.
3. **autogen**: `has_dialogue` without `has_typed_state`.
4. **crewai**: `has_roles` without `has_typed_state`.
5. **agno**: `needs_session_memory`, no roles, no dialogue.
6. **langgraph**: `has_typed_state`, and the fallback.

type: troubleshooting
from: phases/14-agent-engineering/15-crewai-role-based-crews/docs/en.md, phases/14-agent-engineering/16-openai-agents-sdk/docs/en.md, phases/14-agent-engineering/17-claude-agent-sdk/docs/en.md, phases/14-agent-engineering/18-agno-and-mastra-runtimes/docs/en.md, projects/typed-workflow-agent-with-mastra/README.md

| A hands off to B, B hands back to A | Handoff drift | Add a hop counter |
| Built-in tool skips the check | Tool guardrails fire on function tools only | Add a separate policy |

- **Why is a handoff a tool?** The model calls `transfer_to_billing_agent`. The runtime switches agents.

## Harness architecture

## One step of the loop
type: flow
from: phases/19-capstone-projects/20-agent-harness-loop-contract/code/main.py, phases/19-capstone-projects/20-agent-harness-loop-contract/docs/en.md

1. **IDLE**: `run(goal)` emits `session.start`. This is the only legal entry.
2. **PLANNING**: The planner drafts steps. The loop emits `plan.draft` and `plan.commit`.
3. **Budget check**: Each step calls `_check_budget()`. A hit pauses to IDLE.
4. **EXECUTING**: The loop fires `before_step`. A step without a tool goes to REFLECTING.
5. **Tool step**: The loop emits `tool.call` and returns a `PullRequest` to the caller.
6. **AWAITING_TOOL**: The caller runs the tool and calls `resume(payload)`.
7. **REFLECTING**: Next step, or DONE with `goal_met` after the last step.

## Core loop: HarnessLoop._step
type: annotated-code
lang: python
from: phases/19-capstone-projects/20-agent-harness-loop-contract/code/main.py

```python
def _step(self) -> PullRequest | SessionResult:
    budget_hit = self._check_budget()        # on every step
    if budget_hit is not None:
        return budget_hit                    # pause, back to IDLE
    if self.state == State.REFLECTING:
        self._cursor += 1                    # turns += 1 also
        if self._cursor >= len(self._plan):
            return self._complete("goal_met")
    step = self._plan[self._cursor]
    if step.requires_tool:
        self.hooks.fire("before_tool_call", {"step": step})
        self.budget.tool_calls += 1          # count before yield
        self._transition(State.AWAITING_TOOL)
        return PullRequest(reason="tool_call", ...)  # pull point
```

## The seven workbench surfaces
type: concepts
from: phases/14-agent-engineering/31-agent-workbench-why-models-fail/docs/en.md

- **Instructions**: Startup rules, forbidden actions, definition of done.
- **State**: Current task, touched files, blockers, next action.
- **Scope**: Allowed files, forbidden files, acceptance criteria.
- **Feedback**: Real command output captured into the loop.
- **Verification**: Tests, lint, smoke run, scope check.
- **Review**: A second pass with a different role.
- **Handoff**: What changed, why, what is left.

## Troubleshooting
type: troubleshooting
from: phases/19-capstone-projects/20-agent-harness-loop-contract/code/main.py, phases/19-capstone-projects/21-tool-registry-schema-validation/code/main.py, phases/19-capstone-projects/23-function-call-dispatcher/docs/en.md, phases/19-capstone-projects/26-sandbox-runner-denylist/code/main.py, phases/14-agent-engineering/42-agent-workbench-capstone/outputs/agent-workbench-pack/scripts/verify_agent.py

| Symptom | Cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| `illegal transition` | Edge not in the legal map | Change state only in `_transition` |
| `requires a payload` | `resume()` at a tool pull point | Pass a result or an error |
| `budget_exceeded:turns` | A budget limit was reached | Inspect, then `resume()` |
| `kind="schema"` never retries | Schema errors are deterministic | Fix the arguments |
| A write runs twice | Retry raced an in-flight call | Pass `idempotency_key` |
| `feedback.null_exit` block | No exit code was captured | Rerun. Do not advance |

## Glossary
type: glossary
from: phases/14-agent-engineering/01-the-agent-loop/docs/en.md, phases/14-agent-engineering/01-the-agent-loop/outputs/skill-agent-loop.md, phases/19-capstone-projects/23-function-call-dispatcher/code/main.py, phases/19-capstone-projects/27-eval-harness-fixture-tasks/docs/en.md, phases/19-capstone-projects/28-observability-otel-traces/docs/en.md, phases/15-autonomous-systems/10-claude-code-permission-modes/code/main.py

- **ReAct**: Reason + Act. Thought, Action, Observation in one stream.
- **OTel**: OpenTelemetry. GenAI conventions fix the `gen_ai.*` keys.
- **JSON-RPC**: Error codes -32601, -32602, -32603.
- **pass@k**: `1 - (1 - p)^k` over k samples.
- **HITL**: Human in the loop. Low-confidence actions go here.

## Questions and answers
type: qa
from: phases/19-capstone-projects/20-agent-harness-loop-contract/docs/en.md, phases/19-capstone-projects/23-function-call-dispatcher/docs/en.md, phases/19-capstone-projects/25-verification-gates-observation-budget/docs/en.md, phases/19-capstone-projects/26-sandbox-runner-denylist/docs/en.md, phases/14-agent-engineering/38-verification-gates/docs/en.md

- **Why is the budget a yield?** The caller decides to extend and resume, or to close.
- **Why no retry on a non-idempotent timeout?** The write possibly committed. A retry duplicates it.
- **Why cheap gates first?** A deny stops the chain before the expensive checks.
- **Why no LLM judge in the gate?** Same artifacts must give the same verdict.

## Tips
type: tips
from: phases/19-capstone-projects/20-agent-harness-loop-contract/docs/en.md, phases/19-capstone-projects/23-function-call-dispatcher/docs/en.md, phases/14-agent-engineering/01-the-agent-loop/docs/en.md, phases/14-agent-engineering/33-instructions-as-executable-constraints/docs/en.md, phases/14-agent-engineering/36-scope-contracts/docs/en.md

- Change state in one function only. The invariants then live in one place.
- Derive the key in the planner: `f"{step_id}:{tool_name}:{hash(args)}"`.
- Return tool errors as observation strings, not crashes.
- Hooks mutate or abort. Events only record.
- Keep `AGENTS.md` under 50 lines. Load topic docs on demand.
- Put `forbidden_files` in every scope contract.

title: Agent Planning: Workflows, HTN, Plan-Execute
subtitle: Pick a workflow, an HTN or evolutionary planner, or a replanning executor. Stdlib Python from the lessons.
markdown:
## Pick a planner
type: comparison
from: phases/14-agent-engineering/11-planning-htn-and-evolutionary/docs/en.md, phases/14-agent-engineering/12-anthropic-workflow-patterns/docs/en.md

| Factor | Workflow | HTN + ChatHTN | AlphaEvolve | ReAct / ReWOO |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Who decides | Engineers | Symbolic layer | Evaluator selects | The model |
| Guarantee | Bounded step count | Provable soundness | Best plan by fitness | No formal guarantees |
| Needs | Steps you can enumerate | Operator schema | Machine-checkable fitness | LLM in the loop |
| Fits | Predictable, compliance-bound | Scheduling, policy-bound | Compiler optimization | Open-ended research |
| LLM role | Calls on fixed code paths | Fallback decomposition | Proposes mutations | Picks each step |

## Five workflow patterns in code
type: task-table
from: phases/14-agent-engineering/12-anthropic-workflow-patterns/code/main.py, phases/14-agent-engineering/12-anthropic-workflow-patterns/docs/en.md
span: 2

| Task | Code |
|---|---|
| Prompt chaining: output N is input N+1 | `prompt_chain(input_text, llm, steps)` |
| Routing: classify, then dispatch | `route(input_text, classifier, handlers)` |
| Parallelization: N runs, majority vote | `parallel_vote(prompt, llm, n=5)` |
| Orchestrator-workers: pick specialists | `orchestrator_workers(task, workers, synth)` |
| Evaluator-optimizer: loop until PASS | `evaluator_optimizer(task, proposer, evaluator, max_iter=5)` |
| Unknown route label | `handlers.get("default")` gives "escalate to human" |
| Run all five demos | `python3 code/main.py` |

## Plan-execute executor
type: flow
from: phases/19-capstone-projects/24-plan-execute-control-flow/docs/en.md, phases/19-capstone-projects/24-plan-execute-control-flow/code/main.py

1. **Planner**: `planner(goal, history, None)` returns the first plan. Event `plan.commit`.
2. **Executor**: runs `plan[cursor]` through the dispatcher. Events `step.start` and `step.end`.
3. **Executor**: on success, append to history and move the cursor to the next step.
4. **Executor**: on an exception, store `step.error` and set `last_error`.
5. **Budget check**: `replans_used >= self.max_replans` returns failed with `replan_budget`.
6. **Planner**: `planner(goal, history, last_error)` gives a new plan. Event `plan.draft`.
7. **Executor**: emits `plan.diff`, commits the new plan and sets `cursor = 0`.
8. **Executor**: the last step succeeds. Event `session.complete` with `goal_met`.

## Evidence plan waves
type: architecture
from: phases/14-agent-engineering/44-plan-from-evidence/docs/en.md, phases/14-agent-engineering/44-plan-from-evidence/code/main.py

```arch
node | contract | 1,1 | contract | wave 1, review contract | process
node | impl | 2,1 | implementation | wave 2, unittest | process
node | docs | 2,2 | docs | wave 2, check_links.py | process
node | integ | 3,1 | integration | wave 3, acceptance gate | process
edge | contract | impl | depends_on
edge | contract | docs | depends_on
edge | impl | integ |
edge | docs | integ |
```

## Run a replanning agent
type: annotated-code
lang: python
from: phases/19-capstone-projects/24-plan-execute-control-flow/code/main.py

```python
agent = PlanExecuteAgent(
    planner=make_deterministic_planner(fail_step_id=2, recovery="route_around"),
    executor=executor,              # (tool_name, args) -> result, raises ToolFailure
    max_steps=12, max_replans=5,    # both budgets are hard
)
res = agent.run("ship the report")
res.status, res.reason              # "completed" and "goal_met"
res.revisions                       # list of PlanDiff
r.to_dict()                         # revision, removed, added, revised
Step(2, "transform", {"mode": "v2"}, "computed via fallback")
```

## HTN planner with LLM fallback
type: annotated-code
lang: python
from: phases/14-agent-engineering/11-planning-htn-and-evolutionary/code/main.py

```python
op = Operator("open_editor", ("logged_in",), ("editor_open",))
m = Method("ship_change_m1", "ship_change", ("logged_in",),
           ("open_editor", "write_tests", "run_tests", "open_pr"))
planner = HTNPlanner(operators=operators, methods=methods, llm=llm)
plan = planner.plan("ship_change", {"logged_in"})  # list of operators or None
planner.cached_methods      # LLM decompositions kept for the next call
planner.llm.calls           # 0 new calls on a cache hit
```

## Planning terms
type: concepts
from: phases/14-agent-engineering/11-planning-htn-and-evolutionary/docs/en.md, phases/14-agent-engineering/12-anthropic-workflow-patterns/docs/en.md, phases/19-capstone-projects/24-plan-execute-control-flow/docs/en.md

- **Operator**: primitive action with preconditions and effects.
- **Method**: a way to break a compound task into subtasks, with preconditions.
- **ChatHTN**: the symbolic planner asks the LLM when no method matches.
- **Fitness function**: deterministic, machine-checkable score over outputs.
- **Augmented LLM**: LLM plus search, tools and memory. The atomic unit.
- **expected_outcome**: planner's success condition. The executor does not enforce it.
- **Replan**: hand the error to the planner. This turns a script into an agent.

## Defaults
type: defaults
from: phases/19-capstone-projects/24-plan-execute-control-flow/code/main.py, phases/19-capstone-projects/24-plan-execute-control-flow/docs/en.md, phases/14-agent-engineering/11-planning-htn-and-evolutionary/code/main.py, phases/14-agent-engineering/12-anthropic-workflow-patterns/code/main.py

| Setting | Default | Note |
|---|---|---|
| `max_steps` | `12` | All step executions, replans included |
| `max_replans` | `5` | Planner calls after the first plan |
| `max_depth` | `12` | HTN recursion limit, then None |
| `max_iter` | `5` | Evaluator-optimizer rounds |
| `n` | `5` | Voters in `parallel_vote` |
| `generations` | `12` | Evolutionary demo, keep top 3 of 6 |

## Failures and fixes
type: troubleshooting
from: phases/19-capstone-projects/24-plan-execute-control-flow/code/main.py, phases/19-capstone-projects/24-plan-execute-control-flow/docs/en.md, phases/14-agent-engineering/44-plan-from-evidence/code/main.py, phases/14-agent-engineering/11-planning-htn-and-evolutionary/docs/en.md

| Symptom | Cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| `failed`, reason `replan_budget` | Planner returns the same broken plan | Feed `last_error` and route around it |
| `failed`, reason `step_budget` | Replans add steps past `max_steps` | Shorter plans or reuse history |
| `failed`, reason `no_plan` | Planner returned `[]` | Add a recovery plan for that error |
| `dependency cycle among:` | Items wait on each other | Resolve the disagreement behind it |
| `has no repository evidence` | Item has empty `evidence` | Cite a repository fact |
| `has no proof command` | Empty `proof` | Give one exact check |
| HTN soundness collapses | No precondition/effect schemas | Validate LLM output against operators |
| Evolution does not converge | LLM asked if the code is better | Use a deterministic, fast evaluator |

## Commands
type: command-table
from: phases/14-agent-engineering/44-plan-from-evidence/docs/en.md, phases/19-capstone-projects/24-plan-execute-control-flow/code/main.py, phases/14-agent-engineering/11-planning-htn-and-evolutionary/docs/en.md

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `python3 code/main.py` | Runs the lesson demo and prints the trace |
| `python3 -m unittest discover code/tests -v` | Runs the evidence plan tests |
| `outputs/evidence-plan.json` | Written by lesson 44, status ready or blocked |

## Questions
type: qa
from: phases/14-agent-engineering/12-anthropic-workflow-patterns/docs/en.md, phases/14-agent-engineering/11-planning-htn-and-evolutionary/docs/en.md, phases/19-capstone-projects/24-plan-execute-control-flow/docs/en.md, phases/14-agent-engineering/44-plan-from-evidence/docs/en.md

- **Workflow or agent?** Workflow when you can enumerate the steps. Agent when the next step depends on the last result.
- **Why cap replans and steps?** A capped replan fails faster with a clearer reason.
- **Why is ChatHTN sound?** LLM output enters only as candidate decompositions. The schema rejects invalid ones.
- **Which steps run together?** Steps in the same wave. Integration waits for both branches.

## Tips
type: tips
from: phases/14-agent-engineering/11-planning-htn-and-evolutionary/docs/en.md, phases/14-agent-engineering/12-anthropic-workflow-patterns/docs/en.md, phases/19-capstone-projects/24-plan-execute-control-flow/docs/en.md, phases/14-agent-engineering/44-plan-from-evidence/docs/en.md

- Start with direct API calls. Reach for ReAct or ReWOO before HTN.
- Define the contract before its implementations.
- Give each work item an id, change, evidence, dependencies and proof.
- Emit a plan diff on each revision. Do not rewrite the plan silently.
- Store the plan next to the work, not in chat checkboxes.

title: ReAct, ReWOO, Reflexion and Tree of Thoughts
subtitle: Pick, build and stop an agent reasoning loop. ReAct, ReWOO, Reflexion, ToT, LATS, Self-Refine, CRITIC and CoT.
markdown:
## Four patterns side by side
type: comparison
span: 2
from: phases/14-agent-engineering/01-the-agent-loop/docs/en.md, phases/14-agent-engineering/02-rewoo-plan-and-execute/docs/en.md, phases/14-agent-engineering/03-reflexion-verbal-rl/docs/en.md, phases/14-agent-engineering/04-tree-of-thoughts-lats/docs/en.md, phases/11-llm-engineering/02-few-shot-cot/docs/en.md

| Factor | ReAct | ReWOO | Reflexion | ToT / LATS |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Roles | Thought, Action, Observation | Planner, Workers, Solver | Actor, Evaluator, Self-Reflector | Policy, value function, search |
| LLM calls | One for each step | One plan, one solve | One run for each trial | One for each node |
| Observations | In every step | Not in the planner | As reflections in the next trial | Mixed into the value function |
| Token cost | Grows with depth | About 5x fewer on HotpotQA | Grows with the buffer | 100-1000x CoT |
| Paper result | ALFWorld +34 points | HotpotQA +4 accuracy | Beats ReAct on ALFWorld | Game of 24: 4% to 74% |
| Main failure | Loop length explosion | Static plan | Memory rot | Noisy evaluator |

## Use each pattern when
type: concepts
from: phases/14-agent-engineering/02-rewoo-plan-and-execute/docs/en.md, phases/14-agent-engineering/03-reflexion-verbal-rl/docs/en.md, phases/14-agent-engineering/04-tree-of-thoughts-lats/docs/en.md, phases/14-agent-engineering/05-self-refine-and-critic/docs/en.md

- **ReAct**: short tasks, unknown environment, reactive exception handling.
- **ReWOO**: structured tasks with known tools and parallel evidence.
- **Plan-and-Execute**: like ReWOO, with replanning after partial execution.
- **Plan-and-Act**: long horizon (>30 steps), web, mobile or computer use.
- **Reflexion**: a clear failure signal and a task class that repeats.
- **ToT / LATS**: a cheap, reliable value function. Correctness beats wall-clock.
- **Self-Refine**: no external verifier. One model generates and critiques.
- **CRITIC**: an external verifier exists: search, code, calculator, tests.

## ReAct loop: AgentLoop.run
type: flow
from: phases/14-agent-engineering/01-the-agent-loop/code/main.py, phases/14-agent-engineering/01-the-agent-loop/docs/en.md

1. **User**: the message goes into the history as a `user` turn.
2. **LLM**: `respond(history)` returns a thought and an action, or `finish`.
3. **ToolRegistry**: `dispatch(call)` runs the tool by name.
4. **Formatter**: a bad tool or bad args returns an `error:` string, not a crash.
5. **Loop**: the action turn and its observation go into the history. Go to step 2.
6. **Stop**: `finish`, no tool calls, max turns, max tokens or a guardrail trip.
7. **Budget**: after `max_turns` the loop returns "budget exhausted".

## ReWOO: plan, fetch, solve
type: architecture
from: phases/14-agent-engineering/02-rewoo-plan-and-execute/code/main.py, phases/14-agent-engineering/02-rewoo-plan-and-execute/docs/en.md

```arch
node | q | 1,2 | Question | user_question | client
node | plan | 2,2 | Planner | plan DAG, no observations | model
node | e1 | 3,1 | Worker E1 | search capital | process
node | e2 | 3,2 | Worker E2 | population of #E1 | process
node | e3 | 3,3 | Worker E3 | round_million #E2 | process
node | solve | 4,2 | Solver | question, plan, evidence | model
edge | q | plan |
edge | plan | e1 | topological
edge | e1 | e2 | #E1
edge | e2 | e3 | #E2
edge | e3 | solve | evidence
```

## Reflexion trial
type: flow
from: phases/14-agent-engineering/03-reflexion-verbal-rl/code/main.py, phases/14-agent-engineering/03-reflexion-verbal-rl/docs/en.md

1. **Actor**: `actor.act(memory)` returns a candidate trajectory.
2. **Evaluator**: `binary_evaluator(attempt, TARGET)` returns success and delta.
3. **Self-Reflector**: writes one line, for example "pick larger values".
4. **EpisodicMemory**: `memory.add` stores it. The oldest drops past `max_len`.
5. **Next trial**: starts fresh but sees the reflections. A success ends the run.

## LATS: one MCTS iteration
type: flow
from: phases/14-agent-engineering/04-tree-of-thoughts-lats/docs/en.md, phases/14-agent-engineering/04-tree-of-thoughts-lats/code/main.py

1. **Select**: walk from root to a leaf by `Q(s, a) + c * sqrt(ln N(s) / N(s, a))`.
2. **Expand**: generate K children with the policy.
3. **Simulate**: roll out from a child. Score the leaf with the value function.
4. **Backpropagate**: add 1 to `visits` and the reward to `value_sum` on the path.

## Tasks in code
type: task-table
from: phases/14-agent-engineering/01-the-agent-loop/code/main.py, phases/14-agent-engineering/02-rewoo-plan-and-execute/code/main.py, phases/14-agent-engineering/03-reflexion-verbal-rl/code/main.py, phases/14-agent-engineering/04-tree-of-thoughts-lats/code/main.py, phases/14-agent-engineering/05-self-refine-and-critic/code/main.py

| Task | Code |
|---|---|
| Register a tool | `tools.register("calculator", calculator)` |
| Order a plan DAG | `topological(plan)` |
| Fill #E references | `resolve_references(value, evidence)` |
| Reflexion with memory | `run_reflexion(max_trials=4, use_memory=True)` |
| ToT breadth first | `tot_bfs(root_tot)` |
| LATS search | `mcts(root_lats, iterations=80, rng=rng)` |
| CRITIC loop | `run_loop("world facts", use_critic=True)` |

## CoT escalation pipeline
type: annotated-code
lang: python
from: phases/11-llm-engineering/02-few-shot-cot/code/advanced_prompting.py, phases/11-llm-engineering/02-few-shot-cot/docs/en.md

```python
single_answer, _ = few_shot_cot_solve(question, examples, client, model)  # temperature 0.0
sc_answer, confidence, reasonings, votes = self_consistency_solve(
    question, examples, client, model, n_samples=5
)                                                   # temperature 0.7, majority vote
if confidence >= 0.8 and single_answer == sc_answer:
    return sc_answer                                # 4 of 5 samples agree
tot_answer, tot_reasoning = tree_of_thought_solve(
    question, client, model, breadth=3, depth=2
)                                                   # escalate hard problems
```

## Prompt reasoning ladder (GPT-5, GSM8K)
type: comparison
from: phases/11-llm-engineering/02-few-shot-cot/docs/en.md

## Troubleshooting
type: troubleshooting
from: phases/14-agent-engineering/01-the-agent-loop/docs/en.md, phases/14-agent-engineering/02-rewoo-plan-and-execute/code/main.py, phases/14-agent-engineering/03-reflexion-verbal-rl/docs/en.md, phases/14-agent-engineering/04-tree-of-thoughts-lats/docs/en.md, phases/14-agent-engineering/05-self-refine-and-critic/docs/en.md

| Symptom | Cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| Agent hallucinates success on 400 errors | Error not fed back | Turn each error into an observation string |
| A web page gives the agent orders | Trust boundary collapse | Only direct user instructions count as permission |
| "cyclic plan or unresolved reference" | A step refers to a missing node | Fix the #E references in the plan |
| Reruns get slower, stale advice | Memory rot | Compaction or TTL on reflections |
| Reflection does not help | External failure, network down | Do not store one-off flaky runs |
| Critique always says looks good | Rubber-stamp loop | Use structurally different prompts |
| Search finds a good-scoring wrong answer | Noisy evaluator | Use search only with a reliable value function |

## Questions
type: qa
from: phases/14-agent-engineering/02-rewoo-plan-and-execute/docs/en.md, phases/14-agent-engineering/04-tree-of-thoughts-lats/docs/en.md, phases/14-agent-engineering/05-self-refine-and-critic/docs/en.md, phases/11-llm-engineering/02-few-shot-cot/docs/en.md

- **Why does ReWOO use fewer tokens?** ReAct prompts carry every prior step. ReWOO workers get only the tool call.
- **Why can a 7B model plan?** The planner does not see observations. It learns from 175B teacher plans.
- **What does LATS add to ToT?** MCTS. The LLM is policy, value function and self-reflector.
- **Why does Self-Refine keep history?** Refine sees prior outputs and critiques. Without history, quality drops sharply.
- **Why CRITIC over Self-Refine?** A hallucination often looks convincing to the model that produced it.
- **Add CoT to a reasoning model?** No. The o-series and DeepSeek-R1 run CoT internally.

## Tips
type: tips
from: phases/14-agent-engineering/02-rewoo-plan-and-execute/docs/en.md, phases/14-agent-engineering/04-tree-of-thoughts-lats/outputs/skill-search-policy.md, phases/14-agent-engineering/05-self-refine-and-critic/docs/en.md

- Start with the simplest pattern. One tool call plus a summary needs no ReWOO.
- Stop a refine loop when the verifier passes. Also cap it with `max_iterations`.
- Keep branching factor K at 3-5. K=10 explodes cost.

title: Agent Skills: Discovery, Invocation, Routing

markdown:
## Skill lifecycle
type: flow
from: phases/13-tools-and-protocols/22-skills-and-agent-sdks/docs/en.md

1. **Discovery**: finds packages in configured locations.
2. **Validation**: rejects malformed or unsafe packages before the catalog.
3. **Cataloging**: exposes only `name` and `description`.
4. **Selection**: decides if the skill is relevant to the request.
5. **Activation**: loads the body into model-visible context.
6. **Disclosure**: reads references or assets only when a branch needs them.
7. **Execution**: uses host tools under host permission and isolation rules.
8. **Verification**: checks the artifact apart from the model's claim.

## Install, invoke, remove
type: command-table
span: 2
from: phases/13-tools-and-protocols/22-skills-and-agent-sdks/docs/en.md, phases/13-tools-and-protocols/25-skill-invocation-and-routing/docs/en.md

type: troubleshooting
from: projects/skill-router/solution/main.ts, projects/skill-installer/solution/main.ts, projects/skill-installer/solution/cli.ts, projects/skill-validator/solution/stage1.rs, projects/skill-installer/stages/04-upgrades/docs/en.md, phases/13-tools-and-protocols/22-skills-and-agent-sdks/docs/en.md, phases/13-tools-and-protocols/24-skill-discovery-and-progressive-disclosure/docs/en.md

## Writing rules
type: tips
from: phases/13-tools-and-protocols/24-skill-discovery-and-progressive-disclosure/docs/en.md, phases/13-tools-and-protocols/25-skill-invocation-and-routing/docs/en.md, phases/13-tools-and-protocols/22-skills-and-agent-sdks/docs/en.md

- `name` must match the parent directory.
- Description: one clause for the capability, one for the trigger boundary.
- Add a negative boundary when two skills share words. Test near misses.
- Filter by eligibility first. Then rank. Abstain when no score is strong enough.
- Do not interpolate raw arguments into shell commands.
- Name a dependency skill and a fallback. Stop when it is unavailable.

## Questions
type: qa
from: phases/13-tools-and-protocols/22-skills-and-agent-sdks/docs/en.md, phases/13-tools-and-protocols/25-skill-invocation-and-routing/docs/en.md, projects/skill-router/README.md, projects/skill-installer/README.md

- **Skill or hook?** A hook when every event must run. A skill for model judgment.
- **Skill or MCP tool?** A tool for a typed external capability. A skill for procedure.
- **Does an explicit name bypass policy?** No. It still passes every gate.
- **Does the router run the skill?** No. It emits plans and explanations only.
- **Does a successful install prove activation?** No. The agent must discover it.

title: Agent State Machines and Durable Graphs
subtitle: State, nodes, edges, reducers, checkpoints, interrupts and leased job recovery. LangGraph and a Go job queue.
markdown:
## The parts of a state graph
type: concepts
from: phases/11-llm-engineering/16-langgraph-state-machines/docs/en.md, phases/14-agent-engineering/13-langgraph-stateful-graphs/docs/en.md

- **State**: a typed dict that flows through the graph. Each node gets the full state.
- **Node**: a function `state -> partial_state`. One discrete step.
- **Edge**: static edges go to one node. Conditional edges call a router function.
- **Reducer**: `(old, new) -> merged` per field. Default is overwrite.
- **Thread**: a `thread_id` string that scopes all checkpoints of one session.
- **Checkpoint**: the full state after a node, keyed on `(thread_id, checkpoint_id)`.
- **Send**: a node returns `Send(node_name, state)` to run nodes in parallel.
- **Subgraph**: a compiled graph used as one node in another graph.

## The four-node ReAct graph
type: annotated-code
lang: python
from: phases/11-llm-engineering/16-langgraph-state-machines/code/main.py, phases/11-llm-engineering/16-langgraph-state-machines/docs/en.md

```python
class State(TypedDict):
    messages: Annotated[list[AnyMessage], add_messages]  # append, not overwrite
def should_continue(state: State) -> str:
    last = state["messages"][-1]
    return "tools" if getattr(last, "tool_calls", None) else END
graph = StateGraph(State)
graph.add_node("agent", agent_node)  # calls the LLM
graph.add_node("tools", ToolNode(TOOLS))  # runs tool_calls
graph.set_entry_point("agent")
graph.add_conditional_edges("agent", should_continue, {"tools": "tools", END: END})
graph.add_edge("tools", "agent")  # static edge back
app = graph.compile(checkpointer=MemorySaver(),
                    interrupt_before=["tools"])  # pause before side effects
```

## ReAct loop with a checkpointer
type: architecture
from: phases/11-llm-engineering/16-langgraph-state-machines/docs/en.md

```arch
node | user | 1,1 | User | thread_id | client
node | agent | 2,1 | agent | calls the LLM | model
node | tools | 3,1 | tools | ToolNode | process
node | end | 2,2 | END | no tool_calls |
node | ckpt | 3,2 | Checkpointer | state after each node | store
edge | user | agent | messages
edge | agent | tools | tool_calls
edge | tools | agent | tool results
edge | agent | end | done
edge | tools | ckpt | save
```

## Graph tasks
type: task-table
from: phases/11-llm-engineering/16-langgraph-state-machines/docs/en.md, phases/11-llm-engineering/16-langgraph-state-machines/code/main.py

| Task | Code |
|---|---|
| Set the thread | `{"configurable": {"thread_id": "<id>"}}` |
| Stream deltas | `app.stream(<state>, config, stream_mode="updates")` |
| Read paused state | `app.get_state(config)` |
| Approve and resume | `app.invoke(Command(resume=True), config)` |
| Deny with a message | `app.update_state(config, {"messages": [...]})` |
| List checkpoints | `list(app.get_state_history(config))` |
| Replay from a checkpoint | `app.stream(None, <old_config>)` |
| Postgres store | `PostgresSaver.from_conn_string(<url>)` |

## Stream modes
type: comparison
from: phases/11-llm-engineering/16-langgraph-state-machines/docs/en.md

| Factor | `updates` | `messages` | `values` |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yields | State deltas | LLM tokens | Full snapshots |
| Shape | `{node_name: state_delta}` | Tokens in model nodes | Whole state |
| Use for | The UI | Token streaming | Eval |

## Pause, approve, resume
type: flow
from: phases/11-llm-engineering/16-langgraph-state-machines/docs/en.md, phases/11-llm-engineering/16-langgraph-state-machines/code/main.py

1. **Compile**: set `interrupt_before=["tools"]` and a checkpointer.
2. **Run**: the graph stops before `tools`. The state persists.
3. **API**: answers the user with "awaiting approval".
4. **Reviewer**: reads the pending `tool_calls` from `app.get_state(config)`.
5. **Approve**: send `Command(resume=True)` on the same `thread_id`.
6. **Deny**: write a rejection message with `app.update_state`, then resume.

## Stdlib graph: pause and resume
type: flow
from: phases/14-agent-engineering/13-langgraph-stateful-graphs/code/main.py, phases/14-agent-engineering/13-langgraph-stateful-graphs/docs/en.md

1. **classify**: sets `route` to refund, bug or sales.
2. **Router**: `add_conditional_edges` picks the branch node from `route`.
3. **Branch**: writes a `ticket` such as `BUG-...`.
4. **human_gate**: no `human_approval`, so it sets `_pause_reason`.
5. **Runner**: saves the state, then raises `PausedAtNode`.
6. **Human**: `load_latest(session)`, set `human_approval` to True.
7. **Resume**: `runner.run(..., resume_from="send", state_override=...)`.

## Durable job states
type: architecture
from: projects/durable-agent-jobs/solution/stage1.go, projects/durable-agent-jobs/solution/stage2.go, projects/durable-agent-jobs/solution/stage3.go

```arch
node | new | 1,1 | NewJob | version 0 |
node | q | 2,1 | queued | waits for a claim | queue
node | r | 3,1 | running | LeaseUntil = now + ttl | process
node | c | 4,1 | completed | LeaseUntil 0 | store
node | lim | 2,2 | ErrLimit | Attempts at cap |
edge | new | q |
edge | q | r | ClaimJob
edge | r | c | Finish
edge | r | q | Reclaim
edge | q | lim | cap
```

from: projects/durable-agent-jobs/README.md, projects/durable-agent-jobs/API.md

| `status --store "$STORE"` | Shows jobs, effects and scope |
| `worker ... --crash-after effect` | Exits 86 after the receipt |
| `worker ... --now-ms 111 --lease-ms 10` | Recovers the expired claim |

type: defaults
from: projects/durable-agent-jobs/API.md, projects/durable-agent-jobs/solution/main.go, projects/durable-agent-jobs/solution/stage4.go, projects/durable-agent-jobs/README.md

## Troubleshooting
type: troubleshooting
from: phases/11-llm-engineering/16-langgraph-state-machines/docs/en.md, phases/14-agent-engineering/13-langgraph-stateful-graphs/docs/en.md, projects/durable-agent-jobs/README.md, projects/durable-agent-jobs/API.md, projects/durable-agent-jobs/solution/stage3.go

| Symptom | Cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| Half the turn lost | No `add_messages` reducer | `Annotated[list, add_messages]` |
| No resume or time-travel | No checkpointer | `MemorySaver` in tests, a real store in prod |
| Harm before approval | Interrupt after the side effect | Interrupt before the side effect node |
| Tool state lost on resume | Checkpoints too small | Serialize the full state |
| Resume gives a new result | Non-deterministic node | Capture seeds, clock and API replies |
| Old worker completion fails | Version or lease changed | Expected. `Finish` fences stale workers |
| Enqueue `conflict` | Changed text under an old ID | Use a new identifier |
| Exit code 86 | `--crash-after` set | Expected. Run the worker again |

## Q&A
type: qa
from: phases/11-llm-engineering/16-langgraph-state-machines/docs/en.md, phases/14-agent-engineering/13-langgraph-stateful-graphs/docs/en.md, projects/durable-agent-jobs/README.md, projects/durable-agent-jobs/solution/stage2.go, projects/durable-agent-jobs/solution/stage3.go

- **What does `None` as input do?** It replays from the given checkpoint.
- **Why completed v4 after one crash?** Claim, reclaim, claim and finish each add 1.
- **Is execution exactly once?** No. It is at least once.
- **Why no duplicate receipt?** The local immutable receipt makes the effect idempotent.
- **When does `Reclaim` fire?** On a running job with `now` at or past `LeaseUntil`.
- **Which three topologies?** Supervisor, swarm and hierarchical.

## Tips
type: tips
from: phases/11-llm-engineering/16-langgraph-state-machines/docs/en.md, phases/14-agent-engineering/13-langgraph-stateful-graphs/docs/en.md, projects/durable-agent-jobs/README.md

- Name the nodes first. Each decision or side effect is a node.
- Hoist task fields such as `plan` and `budget` out of `messages`.
- Prefer linear chains with occasional branches.
- Put approvals on the edge into a side-effecting node.
- Do not put the job store on NFS.
- Use a new store for each repeatable crash test.

title: Agent Tool Use and Skill Libraries
subtitle: Define, validate, dispatch and secure tool calls. Store skills as code, retrieve, compose and refine them.

## The function calling loop
type: architecture

```arch
node | user | 1,1 | User | sends a message | client
node | app | 2,1 | Application | executes tools | process
node | model | 3,1 | Model | decides the call | model
node | tool | 2,2 | Tool | get_weather("Tokyo") | process
node | reg | 3,2 | Tool definitions | JSON Schema | store
edge | user | app | message
edge | app | model | messages + tool definitions
edge | model | app | tool_call
edge | app | tool | execute
edge | tool | app | result
edge | reg | model | schemas
```

type: annotated-code

## Registry with structured errors
